question: Speed of five cars C1, C2, C3, C4 and C5 are compared. Speed of C1 is more than only one car. Speed of C5 is more than four cars. Speed of C4 is more than C1 but less than C3 and C5. Speed of how many cars is less than the speed of C3?
solution:
Given: Five cars C1, C2, C3, C4, and C5.

1) C1 is faster than only one car.

__ > __ > __ > C1 > __

2) C5 is faster than four cars, which means it's the fastest.

C5 > __ > __ > C1 > __</p&
